notes.title: Indie Arena Booth - Showcase demo!
notes.content:
Ahoy Atlanteans! 
We've been preparing for something quite special: the Indie Arena Booth is a space for indie developers to show their game at the biggest game conference in the world, and we'll be part of it!
Of course we want to make sure we have a good build for that, and we'd love your help to make it even better.

There's a lot of improvements since the last update, though it's also a different type of build now: The showcase build is a lot more linear.
Here's a quick overview of some prominent changes:

[list]
[*]Abilities: Characters can now unlock different special abilities when they level up, unique to the characters and with a lot more variety between abilities than before
[*]Animations: All units in this demo are fully animated! No more PNG wobbling to simulate movement!
[*]UI update: All interactible elements have a more defined style
[*]Chat UI and event UI have had a major overhaul
[*]Battle background updated to more clearly highlight the characters
[*]Walking background updated with a lot more world-building related assets
[*]A lot of fixes and improvements!
[/list]

If you have any feedback or encounter any bugs, please share it in our [url=https://discord.gg/kv8cmBsjeN]discord[/url]!

Thanks for playing 
- Ramon

notes.title: Big combat update with freedom of movement!
notes.content:
Hello hello and thank you to those who have already tested the latest demo! 
Based on your feedback, I've made a pretty big iteration on combat and on the tutorial... and now I want to know what you think of it!

The main changes:
[list]
[*] Movement no longer costs energy. I repeat, movement costs 0 energy now. It's free [strike]real estate[/strike] movement!
[*] I've split the combat tutorial in two, with the aim of keeping it a bit more bite-sized, so you can defeat your first enemy without dying from information overload. (More to come in this area)
[*] Items have received a big rework: I've removed the items that gave free class actions since they were confusing people and are less interesting now with the new combat update. I've added a few more items that can heal or empower characters, give them a try!
[*] Some more rebalancing and fixing.
[/list]

i'm considering the movement becoming free the 8th big combat iteration of Escaping Atlantis, so I'm excited to see what you think!

We still have a few days until we put the demo live on the Steam page, so any feedback is welcome! If you don't have access to the build yet, [url=https://discord.com/invite/Sqyw5Kgud6]join the Discord[/url] and shoot me a message so I can send you a key :)

- Ramon

notes.title: Gameplay updates: Making energy less reliant on items.
notes.content:
I decided a few weeks ago to make energy almost fully reliant on items. This was to make items more relevant, and basically force you to make use of them.
May be interesting for the deckbuilding aspect, but it was not great for the accessability of the game! I put a bunch of extra text in the tutorial just to explain items, and I believe it was a bit overwhelming. So, I've made you start with more energy by default, and less items at the start. 
This also makes items other than extra energy shells more worthwhile, so it may be better for deckbuilding in the end as well.

Anyway, that's all live now so let me know if you have any feedback!

- Ramon

notes.title: Huuuuge visual update!
notes.content:

[*] Dynamic background!! What?! It's able to have waves and rain and different time of day.
[*] Battle background variations! Was there only one version of the battle background before? Yes! Are there more now? Also yes! And it also has fog and stuff so that's nice.
[*] Enemy animations! Only the first three, the rest have extremely placeholder animations. EXTREMELY placeholder.
[*] Oh and the turtle actually slows down time now, visually. It was doing it before too, it just wasn't showing it off. It's certainly showing it off now!
[/list]

notes.title: Update to match beta with upcoming demo
notes.content:
Some changes to make the demo more friendly to new players!

- "New game" and "Play" options from menu replaced by "New Run" and "New Run+"
- New Run is made a bit easier, so it's less likely to get players killed as they're trying to figure out what is going on
- New Run+ is the previous difficulty, though some small changes have been made e.g. archers only being able to charge up twice, which increases the difficulty slightly.

notes.title: Pre- Turn Based Carnival update!
notes.content:
After showing the build to people at live events, we've come up with a few improvements to make it easier to get into.
The main thing is:
- Tips!
We now have a few tips that appear in certain situations, e.g. when your turtle is about to take damage if you press end turn. Hopefully this will help players get used to some of the mechanics more smoothly.

Other than that we've also made defeating all enemies now actually end combat right away, as it was a bit confusing before that you still had to press end turn. 

If you encounter any bugs or have any feedback, please let us know here or in[url=https://discord.com/invite/Sqyw5Kgud6] the discord[/url]!

Cheers,
Ramon
